devdoc.details: The StaticTree is intended for deployment on the mainnet only. It is responsible for maintaining and updating the static root. Bridges keepers are expected to propagate the root to other networks. The contract owner can initialize the tree and update its roots.

returns._0: The static root as a bytes32 value.

initializeStaticTree().details: This function can only be called by the owner. It must be called before the static tree can be used. Reverts if the static root has already been initialized.

updateStaticRoot(bytes32,uint256).details: This function can only be called by the contract itself. It emits a RootUpdated event after updating the root. Reverts if the leafIndex is invalid or if the caller is unauthorized.

params.leafIndex: The index of the leaf to be updated; must be less than the total number of leaves.
params.updatedLeaf: The new leaf value to be set.

devdoc.title: StaticTree

getStaticRoot().notice: Retrieves the current static root of the tree.

initializeStaticTree().notice: Initializes the static tree with the roots from the respective subtrees.

updateStaticRoot(bytes32,uint256).notice: Updates the static root with a new leaf value.
